summary: Iteration 3: Full coverage of 5 P0 bugs (PAT save, edit save, chat-input autofocus, copy/like/dislike, chat history persistence + per-project filter). Backend: 12/12 new pytest pass + 100% regression (iter1+iter2 still green). Frontend Playwright: all 5 bug flows verified end-to-end on live preview URL. BUG 5 (critical chat persistence MongoDB conflict fix) confirmed: send→history returns 2 turns; per-project session filtering (home/p_xxx/no-filter) all working; history persists across page reload. BUG 4 feedback API persists vote into turns[idx].feedback. BUG 3 chat-input is document.activeElement after streaming completes. BUG 1 PAT stored on add, omitted from list response (no leak). Only one minor UI refresh issue spotted on BUG 2 (Edit save).

integration_issues.issue: PATCH succeeds (toast 'Project updated' appears, DB updated) but ProjectDetail panel still shows old branch (e.g. owner/ui-test@main) until manual refresh / re-click. Frontend appears to not re-fetch /cto/projects/list nor patch local state with new branch/tech_stack after save. Backend API is 100% correct.

action_items: MINOR: In Projects.jsx after proj-edit-save succeeds, refresh the project list (or merge updated fields into local state) so ProjectDetail shows the new branch / tech_stack immediately without page reload. Backend already returns {ok:true, updated_fields:[...]} — frontend just needs to call refresh().
critical_code_review_comments: chat.py /chat/feedback (line 369): set_field uses an f-string with turn_index from request body without type-validation; pydantic int coercion mitigates but consider asserting >= 0 to prevent negative indexes that MongoDB would silently accept as backward array access.
cto_projects.py /projects/add: github_token stored as plaintext in MongoDB. For production, this should be encrypted at rest (e.g. Fernet) before insert. Non-blocking for MVP.
cto_projects.py UpdateProject filters with `v is not None and v != ''` — good. Consider also stripping whitespace (e.g. branch=' ' would currently pass).
ChatPanel setTimeout focus (line ~287): works correctly per Playwright (document.activeElement === chat-input after done). No issue.
Projects.jsx EditDialog: after save the UI should optimistically update or call refresh — see action_item above.
Cosmetic from iter2 still present: api-pill flashes 'api offline' briefly on first mount.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 new P0 + regression on 20 prior tests)
success_rate.frontend: 95% — all 5 bugs functionally pass; minor UI refresh issue on Edit

seed_data_creation: Created (and cleaned up via test_zzz_cleanup) one TEST_Proj project. Two transient projects p_filt_* and p_test_bug5 referenced only in chat_sessions (no cto_project doc). One UI project TEST_UI_1780183652 was created and NOT cleaned (UI test had no delete step) — safe to delete via API or UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three backend test files now: test_aurem_backend.py (iter1), test_aurem_chat_persistence.py (iter2), test_aurem_p0_bugs.py (iter3). All should pass on regression. Key testids: proj-add-btn, proj-name/url/pat/branch/tech, proj-add-submit, proj-edit, proj-edit-pat/branch/tech, proj-edit-save, chat-input, chat-send, chat-stop, copy-{idx}, thumbs-up-{idx}, thumbs-down-{idx}, session-row-{id}, new-chat-btn. Per-project chat: TabBar at top of /dashboard with Home + project tabs; localStorage key aurem_session_proj_{pid} or aurem_session_home. project_id='home' in /chat/sessions returns sessions where project_id is null or missing.
rca of the issue: BUG 2 minor UI refresh issue: in Projects.jsx EditDialog onSubmit handler, after the PATCH api call succeeds, the parent component's projects state is not re-fetched. The 'Project updated' toast fires but `setProjects(...)` is never called with the new branch/tech_stack values. Fix: after `await api.patch(...)`, call the parent's `refresh()` callback (or update local state with the returned updated_fields). This is a one-line frontend change.
